# Overrides applied when compiling semgrep.txt (uv pip compile --override).
#
# mcp: semgrep 1.182.1 pins mcp==1.29.0, which is affected by the MCP Python SDK
# advisory "Unbounded Session Accumulation in StreamableHTTP Transport" (fixed in
# 1.30.0; Dependabot alerts #35/#36). semgrep imports mcp only for its `semgrep mcp`
# server, never in `semgrep scan`, which is all semgrep.yaml runs. semgrep.yaml installs
# with --no-deps, so pip does not re-apply semgrep's exact pin. Delete this line once a
# semgrep release allows mcp >= 1.30.0.
mcp~=1.30.0
#
# opentelemetry: semgrep 1.182.1 pins opentelemetry-api/-sdk/-exporter-otlp-proto-http
# ~=1.37.0, affected by "Unbounded tracestate parsing in opentelemetry-api"
# (GHSA-xcq7-p3pf-p88h, fixed in 1.45.1; Dependabot alert #37). The whole family is
# overridden together so the stable (1.45.1) and beta (0.66b1) packages stay matched.
# `pip check` flags only semgrep's own pins; `semgrep scan` ran clean locally on these pins.
# Delete these lines once a semgrep release allows opentelemetry-api >= 1.45.1.
opentelemetry-api~=1.45.1
opentelemetry-sdk~=1.45.1
opentelemetry-exporter-otlp-proto-http~=1.45.1
opentelemetry-exporter-otlp-proto-common~=1.45.1
opentelemetry-proto~=1.45.1
opentelemetry-instrumentation==0.66b1
opentelemetry-instrumentation-requests==0.66b1
opentelemetry-instrumentation-threading==0.66b1
opentelemetry-semantic-conventions==0.66b1
opentelemetry-util-http==0.66b1
